endorsements.name: Celada Spa
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-2474
endorsements.description: Authentication is currently unsupported in Haas Controller version 100.20.000.1110 when using the “Ethernet Q Commands” service, which allows any user on the same network segment as the controller (even while connected remotely) to access the service and write unauthorized macros to the device.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Celada Spa
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-2475
endorsements.description: Haas Controller version 100.20.000.1110 has insufficient granularity of access control when using the "Ethernet Q Commands" service. Any user is able to write macros into registers outside of the authorized accessible range. This could allow a user to access privileged resources or resources out of context.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Celada Spa
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-41636
endorsements.description: Communication traffic involving "Ethernet Q Commands" service of Haas Controller version 100.20.000.1110 is transmitted in cleartext. This allows an attacker to obtain sensitive information being passed to and from the controller.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.1)
